sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr.P.Sathish f  Additional Gov  Mr.Abishek Mur  Government Adv  ORDER
By consent of learned counsel on both sides, this writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

2.The present writ petition is filed praying for a writ of mandamus, to direct the respondents to take appropriate steps for making payment as per the Award No.17/Unit-VIII Block -II dated May 2023 to the petitioner based on the petitioner's representation dated 18.03.2025.
3.After submitting for a brief while, learned Additional Government Pleader would submit that the communication dated 17.10.2023, wherein it was stated that in respect of S.No.44/5H, the person claiming ownership must obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and thereafter,
approach the Principal District Judge, Tiruvannamalai.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 17/07/2025 02:10:30 pm )

4.It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that they may be granted liberty to obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and thereafter, approach the Principal District Judge,
Tiruvannamalai, in support of its claim for computation and payment of compensation under the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 and under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the applicability or https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 17/07/2025 02:10:30 pm ) entitlement of the petitioner's right in terms of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

2.The present writ petition is filed praying for a writ of mandamus, to direct the respondents to take appropriate steps for making payment as per the Award No.17/Unit-VIII Block -II dated May 2023 to the petitioner based on the petitioner's representation dated 18.03.2025.
3.After submitting for a brief while, learned Additional Government Pleader would submit that the communication dated 17.10.2023, wherein it was stated that in respect of S.No.44/5H, the person claiming ownership must obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and thereafter,
approach the Principal District Judge, Tiruvannamalai.
6.In the circumstance, it is open to the petitioner's to urge before the appropriate authority regarding the entitlement under the above said enactments and the same would be decided by the appropriate authority in accordance with law, after affording the petitioner and any other interested parties a reasonable opportunity of hearing.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the applicability or https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 17/07/2025 02:10:30 pm ) entitlement of the petitioner's right in terms of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
In view thereof, the writ petition stands disposed of.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
